purpose: Specify the estimand scale and uncertainty definition for the NEXT3 replication criterion without selecting a numerical precision threshold retrospectively.

primary_estimand.description: Action-identity × future-representation-assignment interaction on selection probability, with informative correspondence contrasted against the matched uninformative null.

precision_definition.target_quantity: primary interaction parameter on the declared model scale

dependence_structure.rule: Candidate-action rows belonging to the same decision are not treated as independent scientific repetitions.
dependence_structure.independent_repetition_unit: complete experimental execution/replication as defined by the final execution protocol

next_required_input: Independent scientific justification for the maximum acceptable confidence-interval half-width on the primary interaction parameter scale.
